item.title: 2026 Mayo football championship draws made
item.description: The draws have taken place for the 2026 Mayo adult football championships.

item.title: Bugler convinced transitional Dubs can win Sam
item.description: Sean Bugler believes Dublin can win the All-Ireland SFC title this year, despite being in heavy transition.

item.title: Costello set to miss Cork clash
item.description: Meath are expected to be without Mathew Costello for Sunday's Allianz Football League Division 2 top-of-the-table showdown with Cork at Páirc Uí Rinn.

item.title: Meath's Lynch links up with Sydney Swans
item.description: Meath defender Mary-Kate Lynch has joined Sydney Swans for the 2026 AFLW season.

item.title: Antrim v Carlow switched to Corrigan Park
item.description: Antrim's Allianz Hurling League Division 1B clash against Carlow this weekend has been moved to Corrigan Park.

item.title: Development work on Austin Stack Park set to be complete by May
item.description: The development work to upgrade the Horan's end of Austin Stack Park is expected to be completed in May.

item.title: Johnston joins Corey's backroom team in Kilcoo
item.description: Former Cavan star Seanie Johnston has joined the coaching set-up of Down football kingpins Kilcoo.

item.title: "Gaelic football has transformed again" - Power
item.description: University of Limerick football manager David Power says it's "a joy to be coaching" teams under the new rules.

item.title: "He will be a huge miss, an absolutely huge miss"
item.description: Former Armagh star and current Wicklow manager Oisin McConville believes Darragh Canavan's departure for the remainder of the Allianz Football League campaign after this weekend "is not ideal" for Malachy O'Rourke's side.

item.title: All-Ireland final whistle blower Dempsey emphasises the joy of refereeing
item.description: Ask any player, and they'll tell you that this time of year is for dreaming.
